# GMEOW Procedures Module

The GMEOW Procedures Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/procedures>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/procedures`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

The plan ⟂ execution slice: a prescriptive layer that de-conflates
procedures, recipes, protocols, and workflow definitions from the events that enact them.
Reuses the event stack (Execution ⊑ Event, Participation for agent/tool assignment), the
information-object stack (Procedure / ProcedureStep ⊑ InformationObject), and the temporal
stack (Allen relations over Execution occurrences). ControlFlow and DataFlow are reified
relators following the Participation idiom.

DOCTRINE.
  * Plan ⟂ execution: a Procedure is an InformationObject (prescriptive spec); an Execution
    is an Event (occurrence that enacts it). One recipe, many prepared meals; one protocol,
    many runs.
  * Type is a VALUE, not a class: ProcedureType / StepType / BranchConditionType /
    ExecutionStatus are open value vocabularies of individuals (Principle 9 — no overtyping).
  * Recursive composition: a ProcedureStep may reference a subprocess Procedure via
    gmeow:stepEnactsProcedure; subProcedureOf provides Procedure-to-Procedure mereology.
  * Step ordering at the plan level is via ControlFlow relators (with optional flowOrder);
    at the execution level, Allen relations (before, meets, …) order the actual Event
    occurrences (Principle 12 — compute outside the logic).
  * Branch guard evaluation is solver-side: the guard condition type is recorded as a
    BranchConditionType value on the ControlFlow relator; the actual evaluation stays in
    the solver / SHACL layer (Principle 12).
  * Flat-first, reify on demand: a flat gmeow:executionParticipant covers the 80% case;
    promote to a gmeow:Participation when role / period / confidence / evidence is needed.
  * Two seed profiles demonstrate the generalisation: an ingestion-process profile
    (superseding the "source-packet bundle" idea) and a research-inquiry profile
    (superseding the flat research-queue).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/procedures>
